source_read: https://www.subway.com/en-gb/menu/product/<id>/ for all 212 products listed on the eight category pages (https://www.subway.com/en-gb/menu/category/<id>), fetched 2026-10-11; robots.txt of www.subway.com (200) disallows only /sitecore/ and some delivery-locator paths, no group names ClaudeBot/anthropic-ai; the PDF host media.subway.com (Disallow: /) was never used
not_verifiable: allergens: none published (a product page only links to 'Ingredient and Allergen Information', which was not read). What a sub, wrap or salad figure includes (bread, size, cheese, salad, sauce): the page does not say, so it cannot be verified or stated. Subway's own store finder is JavaScript-only: the ~2,050 GB sites is a third-party estimate.
notes: Second method: all 212 cached product pages were opened in Chromium with JavaScript off and no network, and the DOM text of the NUTRITION INFO list (a different parse from the script's HTML regex) was compared with items.csv for title, serving size and all ten figures: 212 of 212 equal. 31 pages (spread over every category; the largest kcal, the smallest, the zero-figure pages and nine of the held-back products) were fetched again live and read after the page's JavaScript ran, with only www.subway.com non-/sitecore/ requests allowed: all 31 equal, so the page does not change its figures when it hydrates. Held back (17): two products both named Footlong Pepperoni Slice with different figures; rows whose own figures contradict each other (Beef Chilli Loaded Nachos 625 kcal vs 436 from macros, 12x Mozzarella & Cheddar Bites 612 vs 419, Oat & Raisin Cookie 149 vs 68 and its 3x pack, Lipton Ice Tea Peach 95 vs 128, 3x Matcha cookies fat 13 against 8 for one, Coca-Cola Zero Vanilla saturates 300 g); four products with serving size 0 and every figure 0 (Regular/Large Tea, Regular/Large Dispensed Drink) plus Dips (a generic entry); Regular and Large Cappuccino (137 kcal in 244 g against 575 kcal in 390 g) and Large Hot Chocolate (65 g of macros in 72.8 ml). Published as printed with a warning (4): Chicken & Bacon Salad 486 kcal vs 368 from macros (24%), Regular Latte (19%) and Large Latte (22%) the same way (their protein, 2.3 and 2.9 g, looks low for milk), Coca-Cola Original 1.25L sugars 133 g (a 1.25 litre bottle, 10.6 g per 100 ml).
